targets.expr: (sum by (route, method) (rate(billbook_http_request_duration_seconds_sum{route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[5m])) / sum by (route, method) (rate(billbook_http_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[5m]))) * 1000
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route, method) (rate(billbook_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[5m]))) * 1000
